name: Post Bridge Social Poster
author: wpzinc

sections.description:
Automatically publish your Posts, Pages, Events, Products and more to Facebook, X / Twitter, Threads, LinkedIn, Bluesky and more with Post Bridge.

Don’t have a Post Bridge account? Sign up for a 7 day free trial

External Services

This plugin connects to the Post Bridge API using a API Key, to:
– Fetch your connected social media profile names and IDs,
– Send your WordPress Posts to one or more of your social media profiles.

You may revoke access at any time by clicking Disconnect in the Plugin’s settings screen.

Refer to Post Bridge’s Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy for more information.

Documentation

Full Plugin documentation can be found here.

Support

Support for this WordPress Plugin can be requested on the WordPress forums.
sections.installation:
1. Install and Activate the Post Bridge Social Poster Plugin
  2. Navigate to the Post Bridge menu entry in WordPress, and enter your Post Bridge OAuth Token
  3. Once connected, configure the Plugin’s statuses to send to social media
sections.faq:
Do I need a paid Post Bridge account?

Yes – pricing starts from $9/month to post to up to 5 connected social profiles. Post Bridge offer a 7 day free trial. Register at https://www.post-bridge.com/#pricing
